channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: TMZ: ‘Graphic and chilling’ Guthrie ransom note addresses media
item.description: TMZ founder Harvey Levin said the new, more "sophisticated" ransom note received by the outlet in the Nancy Guthrie case suggests "one thing triggers another, triggers another."

item.title: Virginia judge blocks Democrats’ referendum, a blow to redistricting effort over 4 U.S. House seats
item.description: It’s the second time Judge Jack Hurley Jr. ruled against Democrats’ redistricting agenda.

item.title: Kentucky Supreme Court rules that charter schools law is unconstitutional
item.description: Charter schools have been legal in Kentucky since 2017.

item.title: New Mexico’s promise of free child care comes with a fiscal escape hatch
item.description: New Mexico is the first state to offer universal free child care to all families.

item.title: Democrats say citizenship question could derail census test and deter immigrants from participating
item.description: The practice test starts next month in Huntsville, Alabama, and Spartanburg, South Carolina.

item.title: Explaining golden goal by North Farmington’s Megan Keller at the Olympics, from the pass to the move
item.description: Taylor Heise was tired, and she knew Megan Keller could skate fast. The end result was the golden goal in overtime that gave the U.S. an emotional victory over Canada in the women’s hockey final at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Thursday night.

item.title: Tigers in 2026: A surplus of starters creates spring roster intrigue
item.description: It’s a rite of spring: making the knock-on-wood observation that, boy howdy, the Detroit Tigers sure do have a lot of starting pitching. Then the realities of injuries and performance begin to chip away at that confidence.

item.title: Cunningham’s 42 points, 13 assists lead Pistons to a 126-111 win over the Knicks
item.description: Cade Cunningham had 42 points and 13 assists to lead the Detroit Pistons to a 126-111 win over the New York Knicks on Thursday night.

item.title: Lamphere beats Berkley, claims school-record 18th victory
item.description: Family values and hard work have driven the Madison Heights Lamphere boys basketball machine since Bobby Robinson took over the helm as coach three years ago.

item.title: Rochester Adams edges Romeo, pounds Fordson for program’s first regional title since 1999
item.description: Rochester Adams found a way to get over the hump Wednesday night – and with the that the Highlanders snapped a 27-year streak in the process.
